idiom_name: export gate.{read, write} - compiler-generated forwarding aliases
implementation_notes: Scala 3 export clauses replace the hand-written forwarder: exporting selected members of a stable path generates final aliases that forward to it, which is exactly the composition-over-inheritance motivation given in the language reference. The catch is decisive for this pattern: export aliases of methods are always final and cannot be overridden, so a revocation check cannot be injected into an exported member - the check must live in the gate the export forwards to, which keeps check-and-forward in one call. Choose it when the gate already implements the interface and the wrapper only has to re-expose a subset.
pitfalls: Export aliases cannot be overridden (they are final), so a mediated member cannot be added by overriding an export; put the check in the exported object or write the member out by hand.

Members you forget to export are simply absent from the wrapper type - a compile-time error at the call site rather than a silent bypass, but only if the wrapper is the declared type the collaborator sees.

variants.name: scala.Dynamic runtime dispatch
variants.idiom_name: extends Dynamic with selectDynamic/applyDynamic gating every call
variants.implementation_notes: scala.Dynamic turns member selection and application that the type does not declare into calls to selectDynamic/applyDynamic, so a single place can check the flag before dispatching reflectively - the realization to choose when the mediated interface is large or open-ended. The trait requires the dynamics language import to be implemented, and the price is compile-time checking: a misspelled or unmediated name fails at runtime instead of at build time.
pitfalls: Reflection failure modes (NoSuchMethodException, primitive boxing) surface instead of type errors, so the wrapper should translate them into a domain exception and keep the gated surface documented.
Only unknown members reach the dynamic hooks: a method declared on the class shadows the dynamic path and is not gated, so the wrapper type must not declare members that should be mediated.
